methodology.semantic_warning: Export coverage is not semantic coverage. One specific field/call fact does not mean every branch or runtime condition is understood.
methodology.claim_rules: Only explicit annotations, structured Finding/evidence contracts or curated existing-report statements count as concrete semantic claims. Names, RTTI, strings, xrefs and raw decompile presence alone never do.
methodology.not_a_proof: This reconciles recorded evidence. Static claims can still contain mistakes; only selected spotchecks were repeated live. No dynamic reachability or runtime feature proof is inferred.
methodology.address_domains: native VA/RVA, synthetic IDA CIL addresses, and DXBC container addresses remain separate.
methodology.database_correction_note: The audit script itself is read-only toward game/IDB. Separately authorized IDB corrections defined26 verified functions after a compressed backup; exact before/after evidence is included. No executable bytes were patched.
